adds.title: LGBTQ rights in the Falkland Islands (Wikipedia; Prisons Ordinance 2017 equal-treatment clause)
adds.summary: Thin: Wikipedia's 'LGBTQ rights in the Falkland Islands' article documents no trans-prisoner housing data for the territory - no birth-sex vs identity placement policy, no special units, no solitary/segregation practice - but its hate-crime section notes that the Prisons Ordinance 2017 (legislation.gov.fk, in force 2019-07-17) requires prison staff to treat all prisoners equally without distinction to, among other categories, sexual orientation; a statutory equal-treatment clause covering prison staff, with no trans-specific placement or segregation detail.

records.note: No trans-specific prison-housing placement data found for the Falkland Islands within budget. One thin, subject-verified lead: the Prisons Ordinance 2017 equal-treatment clause (sexual orientation among protected categories) cited in the territory's LGBTQ rights article; it governs staff duty of equal treatment, not housing placement, special units, or solitary/segregation practice. Wikipedia full-text search surfaced no prison-transgender article for the territory.
